interactive_quiz_challenge.question: Which of these animals is NOT part of Addo Elephant National Park's 'Big 7'?
interactive_quiz_challenge.success_lore_reveal: While lions are iconic safari animals, Addo's 'Big 7' uniquely includes marine life like the Great White Shark and Southern Right Whale, alongside the traditional Big 5 (Elephant, Rhino, Buffalo, Leopard, Lion - though lions were reintroduced to Addo in 2003, the 'Big 7' concept specifically highlights the marine aspect).

Discover a true sanctuary where comfort meets adventure.
